items.a: Agaciro k'Impuzamahanga Ryemejwe ni intego y'igiciro yatanzwe n'umuryango — 1 π ≈ $314,159 — ikoreshwa mu buryo buhoraho kuri GCV Market. Ntabwo ari igipimo cyemewe na Pi Network kandi ntabwo cyemejwe na Pi Core Team cyangwa ngo kigenzurwe kuri isoko iryo ari ryo ryose; igiciro nyacyo cya Pi ku isoko ni nto cyane.

items.q: Nagira nte ngo ninjire mu Ihuriro?
items.a: Iyandikishe nk'umunyamuryango kugira ngo ushakishe kandi ugure kuri GCV Market, cyangwa wandikishe ubucuruzi bwawe nk'Umucuruzi wa GCV. Koresha ifishi iri hasi cyangwa buto yo Kwiyandikisha ku rutonde rw'ibipapuro.
Ibicuruzwa bifatika birashobora gusubizwa mu minsi 30. Ibicuruzwa bya digitale ntibisubizwa nyuma yo kubikoresha. Reba amabwiriza yacu kugira ngo umenye byinshi.
Twandikire umenye byinshi ku gahunda yacu y'Intumwa. Buri gihe dushaka abanyamuryango bafite ishyaka bo gufasha gukura Ihuriro muri karere kabo.
